content: Bab-Jehová, Dule-Dummadid
Moisés Israel-dulemarga sogdebalid: “Degisoggua, bemar, be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-sabguo, degi, bela Igarmar-bemarga-uklesad imakmalo. A-igarmarba be bane-bane ibsadii gumalo.

Emi, be nue ebinsamalo, be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-be-sabsur-odurdaksad bemar-sunnad nue-itosmalad. Be-mimmigandi, be-sabsur-odurdaklesadi gwen daksasurmalad. Bab-Jehová-e-gangued-oyosad, e-ibmar-dummad-imaksad, be daksamalad.
Bab-Jehová, Egipto-yargi Faraónʼgi, degi, bela Egipto-neggweburmargi, ibmar-gegerdaklemalad-imaksad be daksamalad.

Egipto-dulemar bemar-baregindani-gusmargua, Bab-Jehová, wemargi, Demar-Ginnidye-nugad-arwega imaksagusad. Degidbali, e-molimar, e-ur-napaginmalad bela obelosgusad. A-ibmar-gusadi, bela be daksagusmalad. Bab-Jehová we-dulemar bela oburgwisad.
”Bemar ebinsamarbalo, bemar nega-dulesulidganba-gudigua, bemar-wese-nonikidse igi-Bab-Jehová bemar-akwisa.

Deginbali, bemar daksamarbalid, igi Bab-Jehová Rubén-wagan-Eliab-masmala-Datán, degi, Abiram-imaksa. Agi, Bab-Dummad Israel-dulemar-asabin napa-egasad. Geb abali, we-dulemar, degi, e-gwenadganse-bakar, e-negmarse-bakar, degi, bela-e-ibdurganse-bakar, babatidmalad.
Bela Bab-Jehová-ibmar-dummagan-imaksad be-ibyagwar be daksamalad.”
Bab-Jehová bemargi ise-nued binsaoed
Moisés Israel-dulemarga sogdebalid: “Degisoggu, bemar gangumalaga bela Bab-Dummad-Igargan an-emi-bemarga-uknaidba be nanamarsun. Adi, emi be yarse-dogesokarmalad bemargadga guegar.
Adi, Bab-Jehová we-yar be-dadganga-ukoye-sogsagusadgi, e-wagan-danimaloedga-ukoye ise-sogar-sogsagusadgi, bemar suitibaksaar-mai gumalagar. We-yar, napa-nuedid, gadi ibmar-sanmaked-yalad.

Ar we-yar-be-susokalidi, Egipto-yaryobsulid. Egipto-yargi-be-noargusmaladgindina, be ibmar-gwag-digegala, be dii eogar imakergebed. We-yargindina, deyob sulid. Egipto-yargindina be-neg-imbagi be ibmar-gwag-digega, be dii eogar imakergebed.
Yar-be-susokarmaladgindina, yalagan-bubukwadgi, nebagan-nanaidgi, dii winaigi daed.
A-yaladi, be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová, nue-akwediid. Ar a-yalagi, Bab-Jehová, egi bur nue-atakdiid, deyob birga-mesmaid.

”Ar emi an-bemarga Bab-Dummad-Igarmar-Mamaid-uknaidba be ibsamalale, be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová ise-nue be sabgumalale, bela-bela be-gwagegi ega be arbamalale, degine, be-san-burbagi ega be arbamalale, Bab-Jehová soged:

‘Ani an bemar-yargi dii owioed. E-ibagangi an gebe-dii-wied-owiega imakoed, degine, an napi-dii-wied-owiega imakbaloed. Adi, be ibmar-digsamalad nabir weegar, ibmar-gwag-gullemalad, vino, degi, olivo-gwallu nikumalagar.
Deginbali, be-ibdurganga be-nainugi gagan-ainiega an imakoed, adi, be-ibdurgan a-gaganmar maegar. Deyob geb bemar mas-bukidar gutemaloed, immee gudii gumaloed.’
”Degisoggu, nue salakarmar, be yardakledamalar. Melle be-Bab-Dummadgi bangumalo. Melle bab-dummagan-baiganse-gordii gumalo. Melle be a-ibmarmar-asabin dulluu imakmalo.
Ar degisulile, Bab-Jehová bemarse urwoed, bemarga nibneg-akale bar dii owiosulid. Degisoggu, be-yargi ibmar-geg-sanmake gudoed, degine, bemar we-yala-nued-bemarga-uklenaidgi emiskwaa burgwidmaloed.
”Degisoggu, we-gayaburba-an-bemarga-sognaidi, be-gwagegi, bela be-nonogi ise-gaar imakmalo. Degine, be-argangi wilubyob be edinmalo, degine, be-bebegi be wilubyob nasikmarbalo.
We-Igarmargi be-mimmigan be odurdakmaloed. Ega be gannar-gannar be-neggi-gudiidgine, igarba be nadapidgine, be gabsokalir, be gwisgualir, ega be sogdii gumaloed.
We-Igarmar be-neg-yawagakgi be narmakmalo, degi, be-neg-buarmargi be narmakmalo.
Deyob be imakele, Bab-Jehová bemar-dadganga we-yar-bemarga-ukedseye-sogsadgi, bemar, degi, bemar-wagan, nibneg-naid-berguedse suitii bukwa gumaloed.
”Ar emi, an bemarga we-Igarmar-uknaidba be ibsamalale, ar be nue be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová be sabgumalale, bela e-Igarmar-Mamaidba be nanamalale, degi, be-Bab-Dummadbarbi be nanadii gumalale,
Bab-Jehová bemar-asabin-dulemar-bukidar-bukwadi, bega onogoed. Dulemar-baigan bemarba bur-ichesur-inigwele, degi, bur dutusurmar-inigwele, degite, bemar egi nakwemaloed.
Ar bia be yargi-dogoe, bela a-yarmala bemargadga guoed.
”Dulemar bese galakumaloed. Ar igi be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová bemarga sogsa gusa, deyobi, bia be nadele, Bab-Jehová, bela-bela dulemar-bemar-dobguega imakoed, dulemar-bukwad-gwayega imakoed.”
Moisés Israel-dulemarga sogdebalid: “Emi-ibagi an bemarga soged, biti be suoe: Ibmar-nued-abingalegedi, ibmar-isgana-abingalegedi.
”An bemarga be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-e-Igar-Mamaid-uknaidba be nanamalale, ibmar-nued-abingaleged bemarga uklegoed.

An bemarga be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-e-Igarmar-Mamaid-uknaidba be nanasurmalardi, emi an bemarga igar uknaidgi be aibatemalardi, degine, bab-dummagan-baigan-akudakedse be gotemalardi, ibmar-isgana-abingaleged bemarga uklegoed.

”Be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová bemarga-yar-ukoye-sogsadse bemar-odosale, bemar Gerizim-yarse namalo. A-yargi ibmar-nued-abingaleged-igar be soge-soge imakmalo. Degine, Ebal-yarse be namarbalo. A-yargi ibmar-isgana-abingaleged-igar be soge-soge imakmalo.
We-yarmar Jordán-diwar-obakar-dad-argwanedsik-igar-maidba bukwad. A-yarmar, Arabá-yalaganba bukwad, Canaán-dulemar-bukwadsik, sapur-Moreʼye-nugad-dikarba, Gilgal-neg-nugad-asabin bukwad.
”Ar emide, bemar Jordán-diwar-obakesokarmalad. Bemar be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-yar-bemarga-ukoye-sogsadi, bemargadga-guega susokalid. Ar bemar yar-sunonikile, egi bemar megnonikile,
nue salakarmar, bela an bemarga-emi-Igarmar-uknaidba be nanadii gumalo.”
